name: Samsung (One UI)
note: One UI puts ads in its own system apps. Most of the worst offenders here are safe to turn off. Do not touch anything under com.samsung.android.providers or com.sec.android.app.launcher without a replacement launcher in place first.

packages.label: Samsung Free / News page
packages.note: The ad-filled page left of the home screen. The single biggest win on a Samsung.

packages.label: Bixby Voice wake-up
packages.note: Listens continuously. A real battery item.

packages.label: Air command (S Pen)
packages.note: Only on Note and Ultra models. Disable if you never use the pen.

packages.label: Game Optimizing Service
packages.note: Throttles games. Disabling can raise performance and temperature together.

packages.label: Customization Service
packages.note: Samsung's on-device behaviour profiling. Collects a lot.

packages.label: Samsung Cloud
packages.note: Backups and Samsung Notes sync stop.

packages.label: Update Center
packages.note: Promotional 'what's new' popups, not system updates.

packages.label: Smart Switch Assistant
packages.note: Only used when moving to a new phone.

packages.label: Galaxy Store
packages.note: Samsung's own apps (Notes, Health) update through it. Disable and they go stale.

packages.label: Samsung Beacon Manager
packages.note: Scans for nearby beacons. Battery and privacy both.

packages.label: Samsung Phone
packages.note: The dialer. Install and set a replacement before touching this.

packages.label: Samsung Messages
packages.note: SMS stops arriving anywhere unless another SMS app is set as default first.

packages.label: One UI Home
packages.note: The home screen. Install another launcher and set it as Home first, or the phone boots to a blank screen.

packages.label: Samsung Network Stack
packages.note: Wi-Fi and mobile data. Never.

packages.label: Bixby Service
packages.note: Some One UI builds use this for the side-key menu and settings search.

packages.label: My Galaxy
packages.note: Samsung India's offers-and-coupons app. Pure promotion.

packages.label: Samsung Pay mini
packages.note: Discontinued in most markets. Not the same as Samsung Wallet.

packages.label: Dynamic Lock screen
packages.note: Downloads rotating lock-screen wallpapers over the network, some of them promotional. A steady background-job source.

packages.label: Smart Switch
packages.note: Only used when moving to a new phone.

packages.label: Diagnostic Agent (DiagMon)
packages.note: Samsung's diagnostic log uploader.

packages.label: Samsung Discover
packages.note: A promotional feed for Samsung products.

packages.label: FM Radio
packages.note: Works without mobile data and needs wired headphones as an aerial. Keep it if that matters to you.

packages.label: Samsung Cloud Service (SCS)
packages.note: Backs several One UI features including some Bixby and keyboard prediction. Doze-exempt and a steady job source.

packages.label: Samsung Mobile Service
packages.note: Samsung account plumbing for sharing and Galaxy features.

packages.label: Device Care
packages.note: The battery and storage page in Settings lives here.
